vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is in the includeInReward() function. When removing an address from the _excluded array that is not the last element, the function moves the last element to the removed position but fails to update the _excludedAddressToId mapping for the moved address. This causes the mapping to point to 0 while the address remains in the array, breaking consistency between the array and mapping.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner, exclude two addresses from rewards, then include the first excluded address (not the last one). This will corrupt the mapping for the address that gets moved to position 0.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the contract owner address
2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank()
3. Exclude two addresses (address(1) and address(2)) from rewards
4. Call includeInReward() on the first excluded address (address(1))
5. Verify that _excludedAddressToId[_excluded[0]] == 0
